# Transport sources

set(TRANSPORT_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/nvls.cc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/profiler.cc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/net_socket.cc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/p2p.cc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/net.cc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/coll_net.cc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shm.cc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generic.cc
)

# >>> RCCL-DELTA: RCCL builds the monolithic net_ib.cc (plus net_ib_rocm.cc, generated by
#     rocmIb.cmake into the hipify staging area) instead of NCCL's modular net_ib/ + NVIDIA
#     DOCA (gdaki) sources. Original NCCL `add_subdirectory(net_ib)` is disabled below.
list(APPEND TRANSPORT_SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/net_ib.cc)
# add_subdirectory(net_ib)
# net_ib_cast is RCCL-only (no NCCL counterpart).
add_subdirectory(net_ib_cast)
# <<< RCCL-DELTA

# >>> RCCL-DELTA: transport/ headers staged for hipify (NCCL does not track headers in CMake).
#     net_ib/gin.h and net_ib/gdaki/gin_host_gdaki.h belong to the modular net_ib/ subtree that
#     RCCL does not build, but RCCL's monolithic net_ib path still needs them staged, so they
#     are listed here in the wired transport leaf rather than the unbuilt net_ib/ leaves.
list(APPEND TRANSPORT_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/net_ib_limits.h
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/net_ib/gin.h
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/net_ib/gdaki/gin_host_gdaki.h
)
# <<< RCCL-DELTA

# Add transport sources to parent scope
set(TRANSPORT_SOURCES ${TRANSPORT_SOURCES} PARENT_SCOPE)

# >>> RCCL-DELTA: net_ib_cast sets these in this directory's scope; re-export to src/ scope
#     so src/CMakeLists.txt can hipify the sources and add the include dirs to the rccl target.
set(NET_IB_CAST_SOURCES ${NET_IB_CAST_SOURCES} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(NET_IB_CAST_INCLUDE_DIRS ${NET_IB_CAST_INCLUDE_DIRS} PARENT_SCOPE)
# <<< RCCL-DELTA

# >>> RCCL-DELTA: DOCA (gdaki) propagation disabled — NCCL's net_ib/ subdir is not built.

# set(DOCA_SOURCES ${DOCA_SOURCES} PARENT_SCOPE)

# set(DOCA_HOME ${DOCA_HOME} PARENT_SCOPE)
# <<< RCCL-DELTA
